page: Microsoft Azure M84ps_v4 is an ARM-based memory-optimized virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is provisioned with 84 dedicated 64-bit ARM vCPUs and 1,344 GB of system memory, resulting in a dense memory allocation ratio of 16 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include integrated graphical processing units.

Storage configuration on the M84ps_v4 does not bundle any local disks, meaning persistent storage requirements must be fulfilled via network-attached volumes such as Azure Premium Storage. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring standard external network routing configurations when public connectivity is needed.

The hardware balance provides high memory capacity per core on an ARM architecture, offering an efficient footprint for workloads requiring substantial RAM without necessitating additional compute overhead. The M84ps_v4 is architected primarily for large in-memory databases, extensive data caching systems, enterprise analytical engines, and big data processing applications.
description: Microsoft Azure M84ps_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on 64-bit ARM architecture and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V. The system incorporates 84 dedicated vCPUs and 1,344 GB of RAM, providing a generous allocation of 16 GB of memory per core. The server contains no integrated GPUs and includes no local disk storage, relying on external network-attached storage such as Azure Premium Storage for persistent block devices. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are also omitted from default provisioning. With its high memory-to-core ratio and dedicated ARM compute resources, the M84ps_v4 delivers efficient scalability for RAM-heavy enterprise workloads. It is suited for hosting large in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, enterprise analytics platforms, and intensive data processing tasks that target ARM64 architecture.
